title: Waiver
description: Schema for a time-bound policy exception waiver.

policy_id.description: The policy this waiver applies to (matches Rego policy name).

resource.description: The resource identifier this waiver covers.

approver.description: Email or GitHub handle of the approver.

expiration_date.description: ISO 8601 date when the waiver expires.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 datetime when the waiver was created.
